source: Fallback CWEs for producers whose observation payloads carry none. cppcheck entries copy the cwe attribute of cppcheck 2.22.0 --errorlist. Clang Static Analyzer and clang-tidy entries follow the checker descriptions of clang 18 (-analyzer-checker-help, clang-tidy --list-checks) and, for cert-* checks, the SEI CERT rule's CWE mapping; Infer entries follow Infer 1.3.0 help --list-issue-types. Each CWE is the MITRE CWE entry whose definition matches the described weakness. Rule ids are spelled exactly as the pinned tools emit them.

core.NullDereference.rationale: Clang: 'Check for dereferences of null pointers'; CWE-476 NULL Pointer Dereference.

core.NonNullParamChecker.rationale: Clang: null passed to a parameter marked nonnull, then dereferenced; CWE-476.

core.CallAndMessage.rationale: Clang: calls with uninitialized arguments or null function pointers; CWE-457 and CWE-476.

core.DivideZero.rationale: Clang: 'Check for division by zero'; CWE-369 Divide By Zero.

core.StackAddressEscape.rationale: Clang: stack address stored into a global or returned; CWE-562 Return of Stack Variable Address.

core.UndefinedBinaryOperatorResult.rationale: Clang: binary operator on an undefined (uninitialized) value; CWE-457 Use of Uninitialized Variable.

core.uninitialized.ArraySubscript.rationale: Clang: uninitialized value used as an array subscript; CWE-457.

core.uninitialized.Assign.rationale: Clang: assignment of an uninitialized value; CWE-457.

core.uninitialized.Branch.rationale: Clang: branch condition on an uninitialized value; CWE-457.

core.uninitialized.UndefReturn.rationale: Clang: uninitialized value returned to the caller; CWE-457.

core.uninitialized.NewArraySize.rationale: Clang: uninitialized value used as a new[] size; CWE-457.

core.BitwiseShift.rationale: Clang: shift by a negative or too large amount; CWE-1335 Incorrect Bitwise Shift of Integer.

cplusplus.NewDelete.rationale: Clang: 'Check for double-free and use-after-free problems' of new/delete memory; CWE-415 and CWE-416.

cplusplus.NewDeleteLeaks.rationale: Clang: memory leaks of new-allocated memory; CWE-401 Missing Release of Memory.

cplusplus.InnerPointer.rationale: Clang: inner pointer of a container used after re/deallocation; CWE-416 Use After Free.

cplusplus.Move.rationale: Clang: use of an object after it was moved from; CWE-672 Operation on a Resource after Release.

cplusplus.PlacementNew.rationale: Clang: placement new into storage too small for the object; CWE-787 Out-of-bounds Write.

unix.Malloc.rationale: Clang: 'memory leaks, double free, and use-after-free' of malloc/free memory; CWE-401, CWE-415, CWE-416.

unix.MismatchedDeallocator.rationale: Clang: deallocator does not match the allocator; CWE-762 Mismatched Memory Management Routines.

unix.MallocSizeof.rationale: Clang: dubious sizeof in a malloc size; CWE-131 Incorrect Calculation of Buffer Size.

unix.cstring.NullArg.rationale: Clang: null pointer passed to a C string function; CWE-476.

unix.cstring.BadSizeArg.rationale: Clang: erroneous size argument to a C string function; CWE-131.

security.insecureAPI.strcpy.rationale: Clang: use of strcpy/strcat; CWE-120 Classic Buffer Overflow, CWE-676 Potentially Dangerous Function.

security.insecureAPI.gets.rationale: Clang: use of gets; CWE-242 Use of Inherently Dangerous Function.

security.insecureAPI.getpw.rationale: Clang: use of getpw (unbounded buffer); CWE-676.

security.insecureAPI.DeprecatedOrUnsafeB.rationale: Clang: unsafe buffer functions with secure variants (sprintf, memcpy, ...); CWE-676.

security.insecureAPI.UncheckedReturn.rationale: Clang: unchecked return of setuid-like calls; CWE-252 Unchecked Return Value.

security.insecureAPI.mktemp.rationale: Clang: use of mktemp; CWE-377 Insecure Temporary File.

security.insecureAPI.mkstemp.rationale: Clang: mkstemp template with too few X's; CWE-377 Insecure Temporary File.

security.insecureAPI.rand.rationale: Clang: use of rand-family generators; CWE-338 Weak PRNG.

security.insecureAPI.bcmp.rationale: Clang: use of the obsolete bcmp; CWE-477 Use of Obsolete Function.

security.insecureAPI.bcopy.rationale: Clang: use of the obsolete bcopy; CWE-477.

security.insecureAPI.bzero.rationale: Clang: use of the obsolete bzero; CWE-477.

security.cert.env.InvalidPtr.rationale: Clang: use of a possibly invalidated environment pointer (CERT ENV31-C/ENV34-C); CWE-825 Expired Pointer Dereference.

alpha.security.ArrayBound.rationale: Clang: out-of-bound array access; CWE-125 Out-of-bounds Read and CWE-787 Out-of-bounds Write.

alpha.security.ArrayBoundV2.rationale: Clang: out-of-bound array access; CWE-125 and CWE-787.

alpha.security.ReturnPtrRange.rationale: Clang: returned pointer is out of the buffer range; CWE-466 Return of Pointer Value Outside of Expected Range.

alpha.security.MallocOverflow.rationale: Clang: possible integer overflow in a malloc size; CWE-190 Integer Overflow.

alpha.unix.cstring.OutOfBounds.rationale: Clang: out-of-bounds access by a C string function; CWE-125 and CWE-787.
